digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / parent hierarchy reconciliation
propositions: When a local parent cannot be represented in Jira due to type mismatch (non-epic parent in epic-only project), the outbound differ suppresses the parent field, leaving the child as an under-defined leaf without context.
An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must point the Jira user at the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, using the RECONCILER_MARKER to ensure inbound suppression and prevent re-ingestion.

The breadcrumb is emitted from the outbound comment differ via _diff_comments using a stable identity tag to deduplicate, ensuring append-once behavior even if the nearest represented ancestor changes across passes.
The breadcrumb walk traverses local_parents upward until finding an ancestor with a bound Jira key, optionally noting if intervening unbound ancestors were skipped.
The breadcrumb body contains both the stable tag <!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb --> and RECONCILER_MARKER, with deterministic content including the nearest ancestor's Jira key.
No breadcrumb is emitted if the child has no direct parent, the direct parent is epic-typed, or no bound ancestor exists in the walk chain.
